review_candidates.description: Qualification & Experience Minimum - Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related discipline. Minimum 8 years of experience in data centre operations, infrastructure management, or enterprise IT operations with 3 – 5 years of experience in supervisory / team management roles. Strong experience managing servers, virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery environments. Strong experience in vendor management, investment planning, and infrastructure budgeting. Experience managing infrastructure governance, operational frameworks, and support operations. Experience leading infrastructure enhancement, modernization, and operational resilience initiatives. Familiarity with cybersecurity, audit, governance, and compliance requirements. Experience supporting operationally critical or 24x7 environments. Added Advantage Factors Professional certifications such as VMware, Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, CDCP, CISSP, or equivalent. Exposure to port, logistics, industrial, or operational technology environments. Salary Information Between RM9,500 to RM15,500 depending on candidate qualification, experience and added advantage factors. Role & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities (including, but not limited to, the following) : Manage overall data centre operations, infrastructure availability, and operational resilience for business-critical systems across server, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and related infrastructure environments, while ensuring operational stability, capacity planning, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management of data centre infrastructure. Ensure infrastructure compliance with cybersecurity, governance, audit, regulatory, and operational requirements. Coordinate with application, network, cybersecurity, OT, and project teams on infrastructure requirements and operational support activities. Lead the development and implementation of data centre governance, standards, policies, procedures, and operational frameworks. Maintain infrastructure documentation, architecture records, asset inventories, and operational procedures. Lead vendor management, contract coordination, and service performance monitoring for infrastructure-related services. Oversee infrastructure incident management, root cause analysis, escalation handling, and operational recovery activities. Lead routine failover, disaster recovery (DR), recovery validation, and operational continuity exercises. Manage infrastructure enhancement, upgrades, maintenance, patching, and modernization initiatives. Prepare and manage technical proposals, investment papers, budgeting inputs, and strategic infrastructure initiatives. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance infrastructure resilience, operational efficiency, and service quality. Lead and manage subordinate staff, including performance management, capability development, and operational supervision.

Preferred certifications include CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, and AppGate. Ability to travel as needed and possess a U.S. Government Secret clearance.
